resources.string: Records a full troubleshooting session from START to STOP. Start it, return to a video, reproduce the playback/network failure, then come back here and stop the recording.
Nothing is uploaded automatically. The file may contain video IDs, device details, server hosts and temporary signed media URLs/tokens. Review it before sharing.
Idle. Press START immediately before reproducing the problem.
RECORDING • %1$s • %2$s\nYou can leave Diagnostics now. Recording continues until STOP.
Ready: %1$s • %2$s\nPress SAVE LOG FILE and choose where to store it.
